name: Bangladesh RERED II improved-cookstove access
description: A rural development program supported access to improved household cooking stoves in Bangladesh.

places.note: Place refers to the sourced event; historic political boundaries are not inferred.

date.basis: Date stated in the cited source.

events.statement: The World Bank reports 1.8 million improved cookstoves sold through the project during 2012–2020.

evidence.supports: World Bank reports 1.8 million improved cookstoves sold during 2012–2020 under RERED II and identifies IDCOL as key implementing agency; initial project finance was approved in 2012.

events.caveats: Stoves sold are not necessarily unique households, continued use, or verified air-quality outcomes.
